Test Objective: Verify basic ON/OFF power toggle function
Preconditions / Input: USB connected to stable 5V/2A port; lamp initially in OFF state
Test Steps: 1. Press Power button once. 2. Observe LED panel. 3. Press Power button again. 4. Observe LED panel.
Expected Result: Step 1: LEDs illuminate immediately at default mode. Step 3: LEDs shut off completely with zero residual glow.
Actual Result: Lamp powers ON cleanly on 1st click and shuts OFF completely on 2nd click.

Test Objective: Verify Brightness (+) increases luminance progressively through all discrete steps
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON at minimum brightness (level 1 / ~10%)
Test Steps: 1. Press Brightness (+) button 9 consecutive times. 2. Observe light output at each step.
Expected Result: Luminance increases monotonically across 10 distinct steps up to 100% full illumination.
Actual Result: Brightness stepped up through 10 distinct levels smoothly without flicker.

Test Objective: Verify Brightness (-) decreases luminance progressively down to lowest step
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON at maximum brightness (level 10 / 100%)
Test Steps: 1. Press Brightness (-) button 9 consecutive times. 2. Observe light output at each step.
Expected Result: Luminance decreases monotonically across 10 distinct steps down to ~10% minimum intensity.
Actual Result: Luminance decreased steadily across all 10 steps.

Test Objective: Verify Light Mode button cycles sequentially through 3 color temperatures
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON at Step 1 (Warm Yellow ~3000K)
Test Steps: 1. Press Mode button once. 2. Observe color spectrum. 3. Press Mode button second time. 4. Observe color spectrum. 5. Press Mode button third time.
Expected Result: Step 1 -> Cool White (~6500K). Step 3 -> Natural Dual CCT (Warm + White, ~4500K). Step 5 -> Cycles back to Warm Yellow (~3000K).
Actual Result: Cycles exactly: Warm Yellow -> Cool White -> Warm+White -> Warm Yellow.

Test Objective: Verify upper boundary clamping when Brightness (+) is pressed at maximum (100%)
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON at Level 10 (100% max brightness)
Test Steps: 1. Set lamp to Level 10 (100% max brightness). 2. Press Brightness (+) button 3 additional times. 3. Inspect optical output and controller state.
Expected Result: Luminance remains clamped at 100% without flickering, restarting, or overflowing controller register.
Actual Result: Luminance remained stable at 100%; no unwanted state transitions occurred.

Test Objective: Verify lower boundary clamping when Brightness (-) is pressed at minimum (~10%)
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON at Level 1 (lowest brightness)
Test Steps: 1. Press Brightness (-) button 3 additional times. 2. Inspect optical output and controller state.
Expected Result: Luminance remains clamped at lowest step without turning completely OFF.
Actual Result: Luminance remained stable at lowest step; lamp did not extinguish.

Test Objective: Evaluate switch debounce and race-condition tolerance under high-frequency key actuations
Preconditions / Input: Lamp is powered ON in Warm Yellow mode
Test Steps: 1. Actuate Mode button rapidly 10 times within 1.5 seconds (< 150ms per press). 2. Observe cycle progression and controller latency.
Expected Result: Controller filters contact bounce cleanly, registers each pulse, and stops on expected mode (10 mod 3 = step 2: Cool White).
Actual Result: Controller missed 3 pulses due to poor debounce timing; light momentarily froze before switching to Mixed mode.

Test Objective: Verify whether user light mode and brightness settings are preserved across USB power disconnection
Preconditions / Input: Lamp configured to Cool White mode at 40% brightness
Test Steps: 1. Disconnect USB plug from PC port. 2. Wait 10 seconds. 3. Reconnect USB plug. 4. Press Power ON.
Expected Result: Controller retains previous settings (Cool White at 40%) from non-volatile EEPROM/flash.
Actual Result: Lamp resets to factory default: Warm+White at 100% brightness; user settings lost.

Test Objective: Assess device operation and stability under standard USB 2.0 current constraint (500mA limit)
Preconditions / Input: Connect lamp to USB 2.0 legacy port delivering 5V/500mA max
Test Steps: 1. Turn lamp ON. 2. Set mode to Dual LED (Warm+White). 3. Increase brightness to Level 10 (100%).
Expected Result: Lamp limits peak draw or maintains stable reduced output without resetting.
Actual Result: At 100% dual mode, current exceeds 500mA causing port voltage drop to ~4.3V; lamp flickers violently and controller reboots.

Test Objective: Evaluate continuous operational thermal profile and housing surface temperature under maximum wattage
Preconditions / Input: Ambient room temperature 27°C; stable 5V/2A power supply
Test Steps: 1. Set lamp to Warm+White mode at 100% brightness. 2. Operate continuously for 45 minutes. 3. Measure surface temperature of inline controller and LED bar.
Expected Result: Controller housing temperature remains safe to touch (< 45°C); LED aluminum bar dissipates heat safely (< 50°C).
Actual Result: Inline controller plastic case reached 56.4°C; plastic feels uncomfortably hot to touch and emitted faint resin odor.

Test Objective: Verify cantilever swing-arm joint friction and angle retention under full horizontal extension
Preconditions / Input: Desk clamp securely tightened on wooden desk (25mm thickness)
Test Steps: 1. Extend articulated arm horizontally forward at 45° angle past base. 2. Tighten thumb-screw knobs firmly by hand. 3. Observe position over 30 minutes.
Expected Result: Lamp head remains suspended at target height without creeping or sinking.
Actual Result: Lamp head slowly crept downwards by 6.5 cm over 20 minutes due to low-friction nylon washer slippage under cantilever load.

Test Objective: Verify C-clamp grip and desk surface protection under lateral torque
Preconditions / Input: Lamp mounted via screw clamp to desk edge
Test Steps: 1. Apply 15 N lateral horizontal push to the lower arm column. 2. Check clamp base slippage and desk surface indentation.
Expected Result: Clamp stays firmly anchored without rotational slip or marring furniture.
Actual Result: Clamp remained solidly anchored; rubber pad prevented scratching of desk.

Test Objective: Verify controller behavior under simultaneous multi-key actuation
Test Steps: 1. Press and hold Power button, Mode button, and Brightness (+) simultaneously for 2 seconds. 2. Release all buttons.
Expected Result: Controller firmware either ignores simultaneous chord or handles gracefully without deadlock.
Actual Result: System ignored invalid chord combinations safely; returned to normal operation upon release.

Test Objective: Verify tolerance to hot-plugging inrush current transient when host PC is under 100% CPU/GPU workload
Preconditions / Input: Host PC executing intensive Cinebench / 3D rendering benchmark (noisy 5V rail)
Test Steps: 1. Rapidly plug and unplug USB cable 5 times in 5 seconds into motherboard back I/O port. 2. Observe PC USB host stability and lamp MCU state.
Expected Result: Lamp controller MCU resets cleanly without latch-up; PC USB port does not trip overcurrent protection.
Actual Result: Lamp MCU occasionally entered frozen state where Power button was unresponsive until 10-second cold discharge.

Test Objective: Verify optical modulation ripple / stroboscopic effect at low brightness (< 20%) during video conferencing
Preconditions / Input: HD Webcam capturing 60 FPS video under lamp illumination at 20% brightness
Test Steps: 1. Position webcam 50cm from illuminated desk surface. 2. Set lamp brightness to Level 2 (~20%). 3. Record video stream and analyze frame brightness histogram.
Expected Result: PWM dimming frequency exceeds 20 kHz (flicker-free IEEE 1789 standard); no rolling shutter dark horizontal bands on camera.
Actual Result: Noticeable rolling black bands and strobing visible on 60 FPS camera preview due to low ~500 Hz PWM dimming frequency.
